verdict.rationale: Better Stack explicitly claims an automated post-mortem feature 'based on the incident timeline and Slack' as part of its AI SRE offering, directly matching the story's core ask. However, the evidence is marketing copy only — no detail on contributing-factors analysis, follow-up generation, or human-review workflow, and no independent/hands-on confirmation of output quality. Missing for 10: detailed documentation of postmortem structure (contributing factors, follow-ups), independent verification of the feature working, and explicit human-review/approval workflow.
